answer: Make the economy a tundra, not a greenhouse: new identities start in the cold, earning warmth only by doing verifiable work others can check, like quartz that forms only under pressure over time. A haven of trust should be a place you reach after a long, public journey - not a door you can buy. Sybil farms melt in that cold, because a thousand empty shells cannot fake a season of real frost, real effort, and real witnesses.
